description: Implementation of the number_t class for complex number operations, including arithmetic, comparison, and utility functions.

classes.name: number_t
classes.description: Class representing complex numbers with real and imaginary parts, supporting various mathematical operations.

methods.name: print
methods.description: Prints the number in a formatted way depending on whether real or imaginary parts are zero.

methods.name: is_zero
methods.description: Checks if a double or number_t is zero within a specified precision.

methods.name: absolute
methods.description: Returns a new number_t with absolute values of real and imaginary parts.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Checks equality between two number_t instances.

methods.name: operator*
methods.description: Performs multiplication with another number_t or a matrix.

methods.name: operator/
methods.description: Performs division by another number_t or an unsigned int.

methods.name: operator-
methods.description: Subtracts another number_t or returns the negation.

methods.name: sqrt_val
methods.description: Calculates the square root of the complex number.

methods.name: abs_val
methods.description: Returns the magnitude (absolute value) of the complex number.

methods.name: exponential
methods.description: Calculates the exponential of the complex number.

methods.name: power
methods.description: Raises the complex number to an unsigned integer power.

methods.name: mod_z
methods.description: Returns the magnitude of the complex number.

methods.name: sqroot
methods.description: Calculates the square roots of the complex number, returning two roots.

methods.name: number_t (double, double)
methods.description: Constructor initializing real and imaginary parts.

methods.name: number_t (char *)
methods.description: Constructor parsing a string to initialize the complex number.
